description: Open-web searches in English, Dzongkha-script phrases and Nepali found one opened report on a global letter-writing campaign, but no report establishing an in-country public assembly during February. Search results were repetitive and frequently unrelated-country noise; local media archives were not systematically reviewed and LexisNexis was not available. This is a bounded search limitation, not evidence that no protests occurred.
required_followup: No candidate-specific missing source is currently identified. If a subsequent reviewer or source lead identifies a February public-gathering report, search the exact event/date across BBS, Kuensel, The Bhutanese and relevant original or participant statements; otherwise retain the bounded open-web finding.
